profile.headline: Software Engineer at Seekr Technologies
profile.summary:
Hi!

I am a software engineer with 6 years of experience focused on backend development in Java and Python. Some examples of my past experience include designing and developing distributed systems including microservice based architecture, RESTful APIs, SaaS based products and platforms, cloud-based development and deployment, large scale data integrations and database management. My experience has given me the opportunity to work on systems and services from a wide range of industries while gaining the ability to design, develop, and scale from the ground up. Problem solver and someone who isn't afraid to dive into complexity in order to learn and improve. I'm committed to exceeding expectations, ensuring projects are delivered on time while maintaining the highest quality standards. I'm a team player, with experience working on cross-functional teams and being able to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical teammates and clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer, API
positions.description:
• Worked alongside multiple teams including the Mobile and Survey Support & Automation teams
• Redesigned the backend system of a survey creation service implementing optimizations in the SQL queries and caching resulting in a 50% decrease in average dashboard load time
• Developed a new microservice that integrated several of the leading Market Research companies external survey APIs into our survey ecosystem leading to 25% additional survey opportunities for users in the mobile app
• Built and maintained scalable RESTful APIs for the mobile application supporting 150k+ active users
• Utilized AWS to manage Docker containers and deploy 50+ images to production for our cloud based services
• Leveraged CI/CD pipeline to automate unit and integration tests and Docker image creation 
• Implemented observability and monitoring tools for production level logging and error resolution
• Created an AWS Lambda function that regularly validated internal hashed data reducing production level errors
• Successfully integrated AI via OpenAI API into SaaS platform that contributed to an increase in successful client onboarding
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Java · PHP · Flask · Spring Boot · Laravel · Python · Back-End Web Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · REST APIs · MySQL · Postman · Redis · Git · Docker · PHPUnit · Amplitude Analytics · Continuous Integration (CI) · Continuous Delivery (CD) · CircleCI · API Development

positions.title: Senior Integration Developer
positions.description:
• Lead integration developer responsible for developing and managing backend systems designed to support large data integration initiatives for our cloud-based SaaS platform
• Participated in design sessions and wrote design specification documents outlining the requirements needed for changes to the integration strategy for a client
• Created new classes in our custom framework that improved code reusability and consistency of solutions across clients
• Mentored new developers and participated in code reviews via Gitlab

positions.title: Integration Developer
positions.description:
• Responsible for developing ETL scripts capable of efficiently extracting, transforming, and loading up to millions of records of financial transactions on a regular basis into our databases
• Built complex SQL queries needed to create custom views and analytics for integrated data based on clients requirements
• Developed RESTful APIs to extract client data from external systems
• Worked alongside production support team to identify and resolve production escalations
• Scheduled and automated ETL and cleanup scripts using Cron tables on Unix / Linux environments

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Assigned to the team responsible for the full stack redevelopment of the core customer portal
• Responsibilities included optimizations to the backend system, enhancements to the UI and implementation of a new testing suite including unit, integration, and system testing   
• Worked on a new customer dashboard focused on the analytics of a customer’s portfolio reducing load time by 75%

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: • Designed a HTML editor app for the Marketing Department to efficiently manage their 100+ existing and ongoing campaign emails reducing their weekly time spent by 50%

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
• Maintained up to date techniques and strategies for programming concepts in Java/Python/C++
• Sessions with one or multiple students
• Reviewed and debugged student's code
• Lead workshops for various CS related topics
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Python · C++ · Tutoring · Leadership · Computer Science

projects.title: Movie E-Commerce Web App
projects.description:
• Created using Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, HTML and JavaScript that allows users to sign up and purchase movies
• Features include signing up, login and logout, search, sorting movies by title/genre, pagination, adding to cart, completing purchases via PayPal & viewing transaction history
• Utilized caching for faster reloads and authorization checks, multithreading via thread pools to handle concurrent requests
• Implemented an API gateway to securely manage front-end AJAX requests to the appropriate endpoints

projects.title: Healthy Search Mobile App
projects.description:
• Designed the back-end portion of a Ionic mobile application using Python and Flask that allows users to search for "healthy" restaurants based on a user's specified medical conditions
• Implemented Yelp's Open Dataset JSON file as the data source for the restaurants and wrote a Python script to parse the data and convert it into a dataframe utilizing pandas and storing it into a MySQL database
• Features include sign up/login, updating profile with medical conditions/food allergies/dietary restrictions, search bar with filtering criteria such as food type, and a results page listing recommended restaurants
• Restaurants are ranked and ordered based on a aggregated score calculated using the users profile data against the restaurants food options with the healthier food listed on top
